trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document) WHERE CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0 OR p.current_team <> 'Brooklyn Nets' OR p.nationality = 'French' OR p.current_team <> 'Indiana Pacers' RETURN DISTINCT CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) AS col1, p.name AS col2, CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col3, p.name AS name_player
